title: Counter-Reformation
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Counter-Reformation", at revision 1375213182, opens: "The Counter-Reformation, also sometimes called the Catholic Revival or the Catholic Reformation, was the period of Catholic resurgence that was initiated in response to and as an alternative to, or from similar insights as, the Protestant Reformation. It was a comprehensive effort arising from the decrees of the Council of Trent." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q128168, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Catholic political and religious response to the Protestant Reformation and earlier reformism". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
